item.description: Republican Governor Phil Scott won a historic sixth term as Vermont governor with Molly Gray winning as lieutenant governor. Democrats flipped multiple legislative seats across the state. U.S. Representative Becca Balint was also reelected easily.

Rutland officials approved an extra eighty-one thousand dollars to fund an accessibility trail project at Pine Hill and Giorgetti parks. The total budget is now about five hundred thousand dollars, with grants expected to cover half. The trail will be wider and flatter to accommodate less-mobile users.

Vermonters approved two constitutional amendments Tuesday. One protects collective bargaining rights and bans right-to-work laws. The other guarantees equal protection under the law regardless of race, gender, and other factors.

New York State Police are investigating fatal crashes in Putnam and Granville. Authorities have not released full details yet. Investigations continue to determine what happened in these tragic incidents.
